Minister Rijiju Condemns Indian Flag Desecration in New York

Union Minister Kiren Rijiju has strongly condemned an incident where the Indian flag was allegedly disrespected during a protest in New York. A video circulating online shows the flag being trampled. Rijiju stated that such actions would "cost you dearly" and warned against abusing the nation. The incident occurred before an event attended by RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat at Madison Square Garden.
